summary: JBS N.V. filed a Form 6-K disclosing that its subsidiary JBS USA Holding Lux S.à r.l. entered a joint venture with PT Danantara Investment Management (DIM), Indonesia's sovereign wealth fund. DIM will invest USD 2.5 billion for up to 25% of a Dutch holding company receiving JBS's Australia and New Zealand businesses, with an initial USD 800 million for ~9.64% at completion. Governance includes a seven-director board with DIM minority protections. The deal targets protein-sector investments across Southeast Asia, Australia, and New Zealand, with external debt raising total capital to USD 5 billion. Conditions include a share adjustment if 2026-2027 average EBITDA falls below 2025 levels, capping DIM at 30%. Watch for completion and investment pacing.
